subject: Marketplace renewal — evidence queue, billing batch windows, and telemetry handoff
messages:
From: Sarah Groves <sarah.groves@crestpoint.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal timeline + evidence queue for AWS Private Offer

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the call last week — Crestpoint is ready to move forward on the AWS Private Offer renewal for the coming 12 months, but procurement needs a short checklist from you so our legal and finance teams can align on acceptance timing. In particular: 

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and a short infra/data flow diagram
- Billing samples (we need a sample consolidated invoice showing monthly vs quarterly line items)
- Confirmation of commitment start/end dates and how rollover credits (if any) appear on invoice

We are aiming to sign by Sept 10, but our accounts payable wants to batch marketplace invoices into the Oct 1 fiscal window if possible. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide an acceptance evidence packet and a billing cadence option (monthly consolidated invoice or quarterly tranche) that maps to the Private Offer?

I attached our PO template for your legal team to review (crestpoint_po_template.docx). Also copying accounts@crestpoint.com for visibility.

Appreciate a quick note back with next steps.

Best,
Sarah Groves
Sr. Procurement Manager
Crestpoint Health

Attachments: crestpoint_po_template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Groves <sarah.groves@crestpoint.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.inference>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-08-29T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal timeline + evidence queue for AWS Private Offer

Sarah — thanks, this is helpful. Short answers up front then a proposed next step.

1) Evidence packet: yes, we can provide SOC 2 Type II (most recent), an operations summary, and a one-page data flow diagram specifically showing Marketplace acceptance and private offer ingress/egress. I will drop the files into a shared Drive folder and send the link by EOD.

2) Billing cadence: we can support either monthly consolidated invoices or quarterly tranche invoices. To map to your Oct 1 fiscal batch we can (a) issue a prorated invoice to tie the renewal into Oct 1, or (b) push invoicing so the first charge shows in the Oct window and subsequent invoices follow calendar months. Finance will need to confirm which option is cleaner for accounting.

3) Rollover credits: Redwood displays rollover/unused credits as a line item on the invoice. We can surface both a balance and per-invoice application so your AP team can reconcile.

Proposed next step: short sync tomorrow to confirm billing preference and final acceptance evidence. Can you do 9:30–10:00am PT? I’ll include Irene (legal onboarding) and Ben (billing ops) on the call so we can close the loop.

I’ve attached an internal checklist (crestpoint_evidence_request.pdf) that aligns to what procurement asked — will upload the SOC 2 and infra diagram to the Drive once I get signoff from Product on the infra diagram detail.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Marketplace & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
m: +1 415-555-0127
marcus_lin@redwood.inference

Attachments: crestpoint_evidence_request.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Sarah Groves <sarah.groves@crestpoint.com>

Date: 2026-08-29T12:20:00-07:00

Thanks Marcus — 9:30am PT works for us. Quick clarifications before the call: 

- Procurement prefers the option that places the initial renewal charge into the Oct 1 fiscal window (option a: prorated invoice into Oct 1). Will that produce a clean 12-month term on the backend?
- For SOC 2, our legal also asks for the date range covered by the report to be explicit in the evidence packet.
- We will want the invoice to show a single line for the committed capacity and a separate line for any overage/consumption charges.

I’ll bring our AP lead to the call to confirm the batching requirement. See you tomorrow.

Sarah

Hi Lauren — forwarding the thread below. Crestpoint wants the initial renewal charge to hit Oct 1 fiscal window and needs a sample consolidated invoice that shows: committed capacity as a single line, overage as a separate line, rollover credit application, and a clear service period for the SOC 2/acceptance evidence.

Can Billing Ops produce a sample invoice PDF that demonstrates both monthly consolidated and quarterly tranche layouts? If we can do a prorated first charge so it posts on Oct 1 but still yields a clean 12-month term, that would be optimal for procurement.

Quick answers I need from you for the call later:
- Feasibility of prorated Oct 1 initial invoice that preserves a 12-month term on acceptance
- How rollover credits appear (balance + per-invoice application)
- Lead time to produce consolidated invoice samples (PDF) and whether we can include an audit-friendly cost breakdown for AP reconciliation

Thanks — looping Ben and Irene for context.

—Marcus

Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal timeline + evidence queue for AWS Private Offer — billing cadence ask

Marcus — short answers for the meeting: 

1) Prorated Oct 1 initial invoice: yes. We can generate a prorated invoice that posts on Oct 1 and sets the service period to cover the following 12 months. We will include a "Term Start" and "Term End" field in the invoice metadata so legal and AP can reconcile.

2) Rollover credits: they appear as two lines — (a) "Rollover balance" in the header summary and (b) "Applied credit" line on the invoice where the credit is used. That should be audit-friendly.

3) Sample PDFs: Billing Ops can produce both a monthly consolidated invoice sample and a quarterly tranche layout within 24 business hours. I’ll attach the samples to the Drive folder and provide a short readme that explains each line item.

4) Tax and marketplace fee handling: if Crestpoint requires a marketplace-level tax treatment, we will need a quick signature on the Private Offer amendment — legal can pre-sign the template and we can route to DocuSign during acceptance.

I’ll upload the invoice samples and a one-page readout (redwood_inference_invoice_samples.pdf) to the shared Drive and post the link in the meeting invite.

Lauren Bennett
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
lauren_bennett@redwood.inference
